notes: 18 mythic species appended after 90 existing species. Three independent normal/SR/SSR forms each; 54 unique new trigger/effect combinations. Existing IDs and skill indexes unchanged.

pets.archetype: 颂铃蜂鸟：微小短胖鸟身、细长直喙、两片高速悬停翼、短扇尾，胸前铃状花萼；不是鹤、孔雀或六翼鸟。R铃蕊幼蜂鸟，SR花铃悬翼使，SSR围绕自身的三瓣铃花冠和双翼，保持短小身材而用冠扩大轮廓。
pets.designEn: Canticle hummingbird with a tiny plump body, long straight needle beak, exactly two hovering wings, short fan tail and a bell-shaped blossom chest. Not crane, peacock or six-winged bird. R bell-bud chick; SR flower-bell hoverer; SSR magnificent three-petal bell crown around the small body, only two wings.

skills.name: 奇铃晨歌
skills.description: 掷骰时 · 攻击点数为奇数：恢复生命 +12。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On rolling · with an odd attack roll: restore 12 HP. Once per battle.

skills.name: 承愿赠力
skills.description: 使用生命药水时 · 有队友阵亡：力量药水 +1。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On using a healing potion · with a fallen teammate: gain 1 power potion. Once per battle.

skills.name: 护愿花幕
skills.description: 防御时 · 有队友阵亡：获得护盾 +32。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On guard · with a fallen teammate: gain 32 shield. Once per battle.

pets.archetype: 宙帆棘龙：恐龙棘龙式双足站立、长鳄吻、两只短前爪、巨型半圆背帆与粗尾，单头无翅。R幼棘龙，SR星纹大背帆，SSR背帆如星图穹顶的巨棘龙，禁止长蛇龙、麒麟、多首或翼龙。
pets.designEn: Chronicle spinosaurus dragon: upright dinosaur on two hind legs, long crocodilian muzzle, two small front claws, huge semicircular dorsal sail and thick tail. One head, no wings. R juvenile spinosaur; SR star-marked sailback; SSR colossal spinosaur whose dome sail bears a clear celestial map. No serpent dragon, qilin, multiple heads or wyvern.

skills.name: 双帆龙痕
skills.description: 攻击时 · 攻击点数为偶数：施毒3次，每次伤害 6。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On attack · with an even attack roll: poison for 3 ticks of 6 damage. Once per battle.

skills.name: 绝力宙返
skills.description: 使用力量药水时 · 力量药水剩余不超过1瓶：力量药水 +1。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On using a power potion · with at most 1 power potion left: gain 1 power potion. Once per battle.

skills.name: 承古噬生
skills.description: 攻击时 · 有队友阵亡：恢复实际伤害的 100%。每场一次。
skills.descriptionEn: On attack · with a fallen teammate: restore 100% of damage dealt as HP. Once per battle.
